svg.text: TPC-H SF100 — PostgreSQL vs pg_duckdb vs pg_yaap
tpch100g · 125GB database · MacBook Pro M4 Pro / 24GB · one run per query · no profiler
YAAP: 12 workers, 8GiB payload / 20GiB DSA · pg_duckdb: default 4GiB memory and scan parallelism · PG: native plan
PG and pg_duckdb timeouts are counted as 600s in totals; their timeout bars are capped at 200s below.
0–200s scale · successful values show SQL time · timeout marker represents 600s
* Q1 YAAP result differs: SF100 N|O sum_charge is negative, while PG and pg_duckdb agree on a positive value. Timings do not establish result correctness.
PG and pg_duckdb were tested in separate runs; YAAP and pg_duckdb were interleaved by query. OS file cache was not cleared.
